Nexus Investment Management INC Continues to Hold Position in Magna Intl INC (MGA)
July 9, 2018 - By Robert Crowder
Nexus Investment Management Inc increased its stake in Magna Intl Inc (MGA) by 944.04% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Nexus Investment Management Inc bought 272,875 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.18% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 301,780 shares of the capital goods company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $16.97M, up from 28,905 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Nexus Investment Management Inc who had been investing in Magna Intl Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $20.92B market cap company. The stock increased 0.87% or $0.51 during the last trading session, reaching $58.82. About 733,162 shares traded. Magna International Inc. (NYSE:MGA) has risen 43.85% since July 9, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 31.28% the S&P500.
Nexus Investment Management Inc, which manages about $651.07 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 31,755 shares to 160,541 shares, valued at $26.94M in 2018Q1, according to the filing.
